name: Brother Paxton
summary: At Stormwind's royal archives, Milton Sheaf sends you to Northshire Abbey for a missing dwarven treatise. The book was loaned months ago for copying, but has not returned to the city shelves.

sections.title: A Borrowed Volume
sections.body: Stormwind's head librarian, Milton Sheaf, has a missing book on his hands. 'The Stresses of Iron,' a treatise on metallurgical techniques by dwarven prospector Margulf Blaggon, is gone from the capital's shelves. The book was loaned months ago to the clerics of Northshire Abbey so they could copy it. It was not misplaced in Stormwind.

sections.title: Northshire's Scribe
sections.body: At Northshire Abbey, Brother Paxton cares for the library and its books. The Holy Order of Northshire Clerics values knowledge, but copying a long technical manuscript by hand takes time. Paxton admits he has not finished duplicating Blaggon's work, so the original has yet to return to Stormwind.

faq.q: Why does Milton Sheaf send you to Northshire Abbey?
faq.answer: Milton Sheaf loaned Stormwind's copy of 'The Stresses of Iron' to Brother Paxton months ago so the abbey could make a duplicate. With no word and no book returned, Sheaf sends you to ask how the copying is going.
Brother Paxton is a cleric who cares for the library at Northshire Abbey. He catalogs and copies valuable books by hand for the abbey's collection.

'The Stresses of Iron' is a technical manual written decades ago by the dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon. It records his knowledge of mining ore and metallurgical stress deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Why hasn't Paxton returned the book yet?
aliases: why is paxton taking so long
faq.answer: Brother Paxton is still copying the manuscript by hand for the abbey's shelves. The long work takes time and materials, and he is reluctant to give up the original before he finishes.

faq.q: Where can Brother Paxton be found?
faq.answer: Brother Paxton lives inside Northshire Abbey, home of the Holy Order of Northshire Clerics, in Northshire Valley in northern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What happens after you confront Brother Paxton?
faq.answer: Paxton admits he has the book and says he needs more writing supplies to finish copying it. He sends you to gather ink supplies.

angles.text: Margulf Blaggon's 'The Stresses of Iron' preserves decades of dwarven mining knowledge drawn from the mountains of Khaz Modan.
The book sought after is dwarven craft by fellow miner Margulf Blaggon, and Stormwind's scribes value it enough to seek copies.
At Northshire Abbey, you can see the clerics' scholarly work: copying books by hand to preserve knowledge for the order.
You can see the ties between Stormwind and Ironforge in human libraries' study and preservation of foundational dwarven texts.
